title: Oil Markets Sept 11: Brent Crude Climbs to $108 as Iran-US Conflict Intensifies at Hormuz
summary: Brent crude settled near $108/bbl on September 11, up from $101 at the open of the week, as US-Iran fighting at the Strait of Hormuz showed no signs of abating. Goldman Sachs co-head of commodities research warned of a risk of prices surging above $120/bbl if shipping attacks intensify. The Hang Seng shed ~1% and Asian equities broadly declined on elevated energy-cost fears.
why: 油价在不到两个交易日内从$101飙升至$108，霍尔木兹海峡局势持续升级，市场对供应中断风险的定价正在重新评估；属于持续发展中事件，影响全球通胀预期及FOMC决策（9月16日会议）。Bloomberg为白名单媒体，CNBC从9月9日起同步独立报道同一事件，核实充分。

title: Gold Steadies Near $4,400 as Traders Weigh Fed Rate-Hike Path
summary: Gold hovered near $4,400/oz, supported by safe-haven demand amid Middle East tensions while hawkish Fed rate-hike expectations and rising Treasury yields capped upside. The metal faces conflicting pressures ahead of the September 16 FOMC meeting, where markets price a ~57% probability of a 25bps rate hike to 3.75–4.0%. Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh described financial conditions as 'not broadly restrictive' and flagged PCE at 3.7% YoY as a concern.
why: 黄金逼近4400美元/盎司为年内高位，与美联储9月加息预期及中东地缘风险形成张力；距今2天内仍在演变（9月16日FOMC会议将是关键催化剂），still_developing=true。Bloomberg白名单媒体。

title: 燧原科技688801今日登陆科创板：发行价142.18元，募资近60亿元
summary: 燧原科技（688801.SH）于2026年9月11日正式登陆上交所科创板，发行价142.18元/股，总募资约60亿元人民币，为本月A股最大规模科创板IPO。公司主营面向AI训练/推理的国产GPU/NPU芯片，定位国内替代英伟达产品的高端算力赛道。首日交易数据尚未完整披露，上市后涨幅待观察。
why: 今日（9月11日）为燧原科技上市首日，属于正在发生中的市场事件；发行价及募资规模已由第一财经（白名单媒体）于9月9日报道，首日实际走势仍在演变中，still_developing=true。国产AI芯片赛道高度关注。
